input.title: Women's Apres Ski – Expert in Après (Beginner at Skiing) Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This ski zip up hoodie is for the woman who is a professional at the lodge and a beginner on the slope, zipped on for the chairlift line and the hot chocolate after.

A woman in a yellow beanie, sunglasses, pink ski pants and a pink puffer jacket lounges in a striped deck chair with a steaming mug and her boots up, skis planted in the snow beside her, in pink, cream, blue and mustard with a worn print texture. EXPERT IN APRÈS runs above it in two lines and (BEGINNER AT SKIING) below in one wide line of heavy high-contrast serif capitals: raspberry and navy on Ash, pink and cream on Black and Navy. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small stitched APRÈS in the same heavy serif capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word BEGINNER is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest APRÈS wordmark and left-cuff BEGINNER, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Expert in Après (Beginner at Skiing) zip hoodie fit?
The Expert in Après (Beginner at Skiing) ski zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this ski hoodie warm enough for cold chairlift lines?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold chairlift lines, lodge patios and the walk back from the slopes well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, EXPERT IN APRÈS above the skier and (BEGINNER AT SKIING) below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small stitched APRÈS in the same heavy serif capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and BEGINNER is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The APRÈS wordmark on the chest and the BEGINNER cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a skier, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who is expert at the lodge and a beginner on the slope. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
